glosses: An area or a spot in a drawing, painting, or photograph that is strongly illuminated.

examples.text: The image blurred into the highlight, like something familiar seen beneath disturbed though clear water; he looked at the familiar image with a kind of quiet horror and despair, at a face suddenly older in sin than he would ever be, a face more blurred than sweet, at eyes more secret than soft.

examples.text: Meeting my future wife was the highlight of my trip to Spain.

glosses: A strand or spot of hair dyed a different color than the rest.
